name: Peanut-Butter Jar Display Stand
summary: Twenty-four unlabelled jars on a three-tier S08 floor pedestal with a blank sign card.
description: Original warm ivory display with 14 lower, 8 middle and 2 top jars on supported tapering tiers. Plain terracotta lids, blank cream label bands and peanut-coloured opaque bodies. No text, logos, real product packaging or external assets. Static visual prop for S08 (P2).
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; no external models, images, fonts, textures or brands.
accuracy_notes: Measured export dimensions and topology are recorded above; jar dimensions and counts are measured from the saved source. Jars use opaque peanut-coloured bodies with integral blank label bands and plain closed lids. Display shelves support the tapered arrangement. Static visual asset only; no opening, product selection, collision setup, stability certification or per-jar runtime interaction. Full 17-shop scene integration, physical Android/iOS, WebKit and assembled-mall performance have not been tested.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and shared materials. No external assets.
